item.title: Sunroof 0.2.10
item.description:
- **Far less GPU while the shelf is open**: System Stats no longer animates every change, and only redraws when a shown value changes. Free disk space is checked once a minute in the background. Before, an idle open shelf kept the GPU at around 70%.
- **Hidden text in notes**: `||secret||` shows as a dark field. Hover over it to see an eye; click the eye to reveal and select the text, ready to copy. It hides again as soon as you click elsewhere.

item.title: Sunroof 0.2.9
item.description:
- **System Stats**:
  - Shows temperatures (chip, SSD and battery, plus GPU on Macs that report it) and GPU usage.
  - New Large size with big temperature tiles.
  - Cleaner Medium layout with compact chips.
  - Turn GPU and Temperatures on or off in *Settings › Widgets*.
- **Clipboard**: every row is the same height, with text left-aligned and vertically centred.

item.title: Sunroof 0.2.8
item.description:
- **Smoother scrolling**: the widget strip uses a single blur instead of stacking one blur per widget.
- **Smaller app**: 7.6 MB instead of 14 MB (unused code is removed and debug symbols are stripped).
- **Security**:
  - Clipboard history files are private to your account.
  - Searching never matches inside password clips.
  - ⏎-to-paste only types into the app you came from.
  - Note links can't run files or trigger other apps.
  - Note images never load from the web.
  - The app now uses the hardened runtime.
- **System Stats**: choose what it shows (CPU, memory, battery, disk, network) in *Settings › Widgets*.
- **Resize and menu bar**: the pill above the widgets resizes the shelf, and clicking the menu bar icon while the shelf is open now closes it.

item.title: Sunroof 0.2.7
item.description:
- **Calendar and Reminders**: widgets show your data as soon as you allow access. Before, they kept asking again until Sunroof restarted.
- **Music player**: a thinner progress bar, a ♥ to favourite in Apple Music, shuffle, and 🔍 search (searches your Music library and plays the song you pick; with Spotify, opens Spotify's search).
- **Widgets**: even padding around the widget strip.

item.title: Sunroof 0.2.6
item.description:
- **Clean Up Note is smarter**: "Marc - text" labels get the name in bold. A long first line is cleaned like any other paragraph. Lines of dashes become dividers.
- **Widgets**: the strip is only as tall as the rows your widgets use.
- **Calendar and Reminders access**: Sunroof comes to the front to ask, so the macOS dialog can appear. If you refused access before, Sunroof opens the right pane of System Settings, and the widget now shows when access is off.

item.title: Sunroof 0.2.5
item.description:
- **Clean Up Note** (⌘⇧K, the ✨ button, or right-click a note): turns plain-text bullets, numbered lists, checkboxes, short headings and `Label: value` lines into tidy markdown. One ⌘Z undoes it.
- **Widgets**: a frosted, untinted blur now sits behind the whole widget strip.
- **Files shortcuts**: ⌘⌫ moves to the Trash, ⌘A selects all, and ⌘C copies the selected files. In Clipboard, Backspace deletes the selected clip.
- `scripts/import-unclutter-notes.py` copies your Unclutter notes into Sunroof.

item.title: Sunroof 0.2.4
item.description:
- **Permissions**: the Calendar, Reminders and Location dialogs no longer open hidden behind the shelf. Sunroof closes the shelf first, and widgets show your data as soon as you allow access.
- **Music**: click the album art to open the player. Choose any music app to open in *Settings › Widgets › Music*.
- **Quick Look**: Space opens and closes the preview, the arrow keys move to the next file while previewing, and Esc closes the preview before the shelf.

item.title: Sunroof 0.2.3
item.description:
- **Widgets look new**: each widget sits on the same Liquid Glass as the shelf and blurs what's behind it. Clicking into a widget no longer dims the shelf.
- **Colour**: Weather follows the sky, Music shows the album art blurred behind it, and Calendar, Tasks and System Stats each have their own tint.
- **Fit**: widgets fill the full width. The shelf can't grow over them. Large widgets shrink to fit a one-row band, so Calendar no longer disappears.
- **Rearrange by dragging**: drag a widget onto another to swap places. The ＋ menu now opens right above the ＋.
- **Music**: click or drag the progress bar to move the playhead.

item.title: Sunroof 0.2.2
item.description: - **Widgets float under the shelf**: they now sit in their own see-through tray below the shelf, so Clipboard, Files and Notes keep their full height. Each widget is a plain blurred card with a soft shadow, with no colour tint.

item.title: Sunroof 0.2.1
item.description:
- **Clipboard**: click anywhere on a clip to copy it. It slides smoothly to the top, and a "Copied" note confirms it.
- **Files**: dragging a file to the top of the screen opens the shelf as soon as it reaches the menu bar, so Mission Control no longer gets in the way.
- **Files**: files dropped from a folder Sunroof can't change (such as the Desktop without Files & Folders access) are copied instead of failing.
- **Quick Look**: while previewing, the arrow keys move to the previous or next file, and Space closes the preview.

item.title: Sunroof 0.2.0
item.description:
- **Widgets**: a band of widgets along the bottom of the shelf: **Calendar** (month view with an agenda), **Tasks** (Apple Reminders, or Sunroof's own list kept in `Tasks.md`), **Music** (Apple Music and Spotify), **Weather** (Open-Meteo, a city you pick or your location) and **System Stats** (CPU, memory, battery, disk, network).
- Drag widgets to rearrange them. Right-click a widget to resize or remove it, and use ＋ to add one. Drag the grip above the band to change how many rows it has. The layout is remembered per display.
- Widgets only run while the shelf is open, and macOS only asks for a permission when a widget needs it.
- Change widget settings, or turn widgets off, in *Settings › Widgets*.

item.title: Sunroof 0.1.1
item.description:
- **Automatic updates**: Sunroof checks GitHub daily and downloads and installs new versions by itself. *Settings › General › Updates* has the toggles and a **Check Now** button, and the menu bar menu has **Check for Updates…**. Until releases are signed, re-allow Accessibility (for ⏎-to-paste) after an update installs.
- Easier clicking: every small button now responds across its whole area, not just the icon's pixels.
- A new menu bar icon: the roof with the sunroof open.
- The 0.1.0 → 0.1.1 move is manual (0.1.0 can't update itself); updates are automatic from here on.
